text: Decide which .bowman/runtime files should stay gitignored versus become durable project state
description: Watchdog runtime state is now written under .bowman/runtime and the default .bowman gitignore now ignores runtime/. Decide whether all runtime files should remain local operational state, or whether some future autonomy/policy/audit files should become durable and potentially commit-worthy.

status.comment: Decided by Felix 2026-10-16: everything in .bowman/runtime/ stays machine-local and gitignored (as the default .bowman/.gitignore already does). Durable project state lives outside runtime/.
